COMMERCIAL LEASE AGREEMENT

This Lease Agreement ("Lease") is entered into as of January 15, 2024.

LANDLORD: Acme Properties LLC, a Delaware limited liability company
TENANT: Best Corp Inc., a Texas corporation

PREMISES: 123 Main Street, Suite 200, Anytown, TX 75001
Rentable Square Footage: 10,000 RSF
Building Total RSF: 190,476 RSF

TERM: The initial term shall be sixty (60) months, commencing on
January 15, 2024 ("Commencement Date") and expiring on January 14, 2029
("Expiration Date"). Tenant shall take possession on January 1, 2024.

BASE RENT: Annual base rent of One Hundred Fifty Thousand Dollars
($150,000.00), payable in equal monthly installments of Twelve Thousand
Five Hundred Dollars ($12,500.00) per month, due on the first day of
each calendar month.

ESCALATION: Base rent shall increase by three percent (3%) annually on
each anniversary of the Commencement Date (Fixed Escalation).

PRO RATA SHARE: Tenant's pro rata share shall be 5.25%
(10,000 RSF / 190,476 RSF).

LEASE STRUCTURE: This is a Triple Net (NNN) lease.

CAM CHARGES: Tenant shall pay its pro rata share of operating expenses.
Excluded from CAM: capital improvements, leasing commissions, and
legal fees for disputes with other tenants.
CAM cap: Controllable operating expenses shall not increase by more
than five percent (5%) annually (non-cumulative).

AUDIT RIGHTS: Tenant shall have the right to audit landlord's books
within 120 days of receiving the annual reconciliation statement.

RENEWAL: Tenant shall have one (1) option to renew for an additional
sixty (60) month term upon written notice no less than 180 days prior
to the Expiration Date.

TERMINATION: Tenant shall have no early termination option.

SECURITY DEPOSIT: $25,000.00 cash deposit.

INSURANCE: Tenant shall maintain CGL coverage with per-occurrence
limit of $1,000,000 and aggregate limit of $1,500,000.

PARKING: 4 spaces per 1,000 RSF (40 spaces total), no charge.

GOVERNING LAW: State of Texas.
